title: Lazar's ominous feeling inside a craft

tellings.quote: It's a real ominous, creepy feeling. And a lot of it is because of the black just it doesn't it doesn't look right.

plain: Being inside one of the craft gives you 'a real ominous, creepy feeling', says Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on recovered non-human craft for the US government. He tells Michels that much of the feeling comes from the black surfaces inside, which he says simply do not 'look right'.
